newsitem.title: DENMARK: Denmark trims 1996 budget deficit forecast.
newsitem.headline: Denmark trims 1996 budget deficit forecast.

text.p: Denmark's finance ministry said on Monday that higher-than-expected tax revenues enabled it to trim its estimate for the 1996 state budget deficit to 22.9 billion crowns from 25.0 billion previously.

A ministry statement said 1996 accounts were not yet finalised, but a provisional reckoning showed revenue of 363.9 billion crowns ($57 billion) and spending of 386.8 billion, compared to budgeted revenue of 354.6 billion and spending of 384.1 billion.
A government estimate last December revised the estimated shortfall to 25 billion crowns.
The 1995 deficit was 31.2 billion crowns. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650 ($ = 6.384 Danish Crowns)
